title: Idle p4d GPU instances left running
true_cause: Two p4d.24xlarge instances launched for an experiment were never stopped.

title: NAT Gateway processing surge from misrouted S3 traffic
true_cause: A new Spark job read S3 through the NAT Gateway because the VPC endpoint route was missing.

title: Gradual CloudWatch log ingestion creep (DEBUG logging)
true_cause: A release switched the checkout service log level to DEBUG; ingestion grew as traffic was routed to the new version.

title: Recursive Lambda invocation loop in staging
true_cause: An S3-triggered function wrote back to its own bucket, re-triggering itself until the concurrency limit.

title: Cross-region snapshot copy traffic
true_cause: A DR job copied full (not incremental) RDS snapshots from ap-south-1 to eu-west-1.

title: Forgotten load-test fleet in staging
true_cause: An autoscaling group created for a load test kept 40 extra m6i.large instances running.

title: Savings Plan expiry raised EC2 unit price
true_cause: The 1-year Compute Savings Plan covering the search fleet expired on 31 Jul and was not renewed until 15 Aug.

title: RDS storage I/O spike from missing index
true_cause: A new report query did full-table scans because an index was dropped in a migration.
